no-restricted-syntax.message: Use the design tokens and scales: no dark: variants, text-white (text-on-signal / text-ink), rounded-none (a base rule squares controls), per-element focus rings (one global :focus-visible), arbitrary text-[Npx] sizes, or bg-black (bg-scrim). See CLAUDE.md, 'Scales'.
